why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Connect to GitHub with an SSH key' (passes: ssh -T git@github.com greets the learner by their GitHub user name). First connection: the learner typed yes at the fingerprint question, and GitHub answered 'Hi ada-learner! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.' ssh -T to GitHub always exits 1 (no shell), so the run reports exit code 1 on success. Done.

step.title: Test the connection
step.instructions: Run ssh -T git@github.com. Type yes if it asks about github.com's fingerprint. GitHub should greet you by your user name.
